title: S4-IMPORT-01 — Image import is explicit.
goal: Importing is an explicit choice: the File menu offers Import... next to Projects, New drawing and Canvas size, and opening and closing the menu changes nothing. The import itself needs a test file, which this run does not supply.

steps.why: Import is offered as its own explicit action.

cliOnly: image import as a new layer, a replaced layer and a new frame, Cancel and Undo with known PNG fixtures (needs uploaded test files; tests/production/imageImportSafety.spec.ts, tests/production/remainingAuditSafety.spec.ts)
